name: com.archlooks/projects
description: Search 65k+ architecture & interior design projects; x402-gated agent access ($0.01, USDC)

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Full-text search over the archlooks gallery (title, designer, city, country, category). Returns project ids — follow up with get_project_card for metadata or access_project (paid).

query.description: Search text, e.g. "hotel lobby" or designer name

tools.name: get_project_card
tools.description: Public metadata card for one project: title, designer, location, type, preview image, canonical URL, license note. Same payload as GET /x402/card/{id}.json.

tools.name: access_project
tools.description: x402-gated project page access, $0.01. Call without `payment` to get the offer (accepts: Base USDC via EIP-3009 gasless, or legacy on-chain USDC/USDT/PYUSD on Solana/Tron/EVM). Then retry with payment.payload (base64 PaymentPayload) or payment.tx_hash + payment.network. Returns access_token + canonical URL.
